speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates

send-it.name: Spec to PR, unattended
send-it.description: specify → plan → tasks → screenshots → implement → screenshots → ship; no gates, ends in an open PR with before/after UI screenshots. Requires the `screenshots` and `ship` extensions.

yolo.name: Full SDD Cycle - no gates
yolo.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement without review gates

send-it-checked.name: Spec to PR, unattended, with review and QA
send-it-checked.description: send-it plus staff review and QA, each with one fix-and-re-run pass, before shipping — with before/after UI screenshots. Requires the `screenshots`, `ship`, `staff-review` and `qa` extensions.
